title: Shattered Flail
summary: A +2 mace that heals on hit and can drive its wielder mad.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d6 + 2 Bludgeoning plus Strength. +2 to attack. Simple one-handed, dippable, 5 ft melee.
fields.Yeenoghu’s Gift: Enemy melee damage with this flail heals 1d6 per damage instance and grants a 6-turn window. At the end of turns without an enemy hit with the flail, hidden DC 10 Wisdom save prevents 1 turn of Madness. New hits do not refresh the window. Does not trigger on-heal gear or apply when thrown. Madness makes you uncontrollably hostile to nearby allies and enemies.
fields.Concussive Smash: Action with proficiency once per Short Rest. Deal weapon damage on hit. Constitution save vs higher of spell save DC or weapon-action DC +2 avoids Dazed for 2 turns. Dazed removes Dexterity AC bonus and reactions and gives disadvantage on Wisdom saves. Help ends it.
fields.Acquisition: Carried by Flind, the gnoll attacking the Zhentarim caravan.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
